# Telecom RAG Agent

[![Open In Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/assets/colab-badge.svg)](https://colab.research.google.com/github/CrashingGuru/Sandbox_Training/blob/main/notebooks/telecom-rag-agent/notebook/Telecom_RAG_Agent.ipynb)

A small retrieval-augmented telecom agent: retrieves context from a TeleQnA knowledge base, then answers a multiple-choice question or refuses when confidence is low. Dependencies (embedder + LLM) are injected, so the definition is reusable and testable with stubs. Maps the refusal guardrail to the UAE AI Charter (human oversight / robustness).
